declaration.preface: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics is committed to conducting business with integrity, transparency, and accountability. As a company operating in the cosmetics industry, we recognize our responsibility to uphold the highest ethical standards in all aspects of our operations. Ethical behaviour is fundamental to building trust with our customers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders. This Ethics Policy serves as a guiding framework for ethical decision-making within our organization. It defines our commitments to compliance, fair business practices, human rights, environmental responsibility, data privacy, and whistleblower protection.
declaration.declaration:
At Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics, we integrate ethical considerations into our daily operations and decision-making processes. Our approach is rooted in embedding ethical values into corporate culture is essential and can be achieved through effective leadership and employee engagement. Regular risk assessments should be conducted to identify and mitigate potential ethical issues. Additionally, providing training programs enhances awareness and understanding of ethical standards. It is crucial to establish clear policies and procedures that guide ethical behavior across all business functions. Collaborating with industry partners, NGOs, and regulatory bodies helps organizations stay aligned with global ethical standards.

We set annually goals, develop necessary capabilities, and commit appropriate resources to achieve this policy through innovation, operational efficiency, and aligning Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics supply chain with this policy.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

Compliance with Laws and Regulations: All relevant national and international laws and regulations are closely adhered to by Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics. We guarantee compliance with labor laws, environmental rules, anti-corruption laws, and ethical business practices.
Ethical Supply Chains: We continuously engage with our suppliers to ensure fair labor practices, responsible sourcing, and ethical procurement.
Diversity and Inclusion: We foster a workplace that values diversity, promotes equal opportunities, and supports a culture of inclusivity.
Anti-Corruption: We uphold strict anti-corruption policies and ensure that all business dealings are conducted with honesty and transparency.

We are committed to maintaining a strict policy of zero tolerance towards any form of corruption. This unwavering stance reflects our dedication to integrity and ethical conduct in all our operations.
Report any suspicious activities or bribery attempts to the Compliance Officer.
Maintain clear and transparent records of all financial transactions.
Adhere to all anti-corruption policies and training requirements.
Refuse gifts or incentives from suppliers that may influence business decisions.
Do not offer or accept bribes in any form.
Do not falsify or manipulate financial records.
Do not engage in fraudulent business dealings or misrepresent facts.
Do not ignore or withhold information regarding corruption risks.
Employee Training: We provide regular training on ethical standards, compliance, and corporate responsibility to all employees and stakeholders.
Sustainability: We integrate sustainable solutions in product development, manufacturing, and distribution to minimize environmental impact.
Information Security and Data Protection: We uphold the highest standards of data privacy and security to protect the personal and business information of our employees, customers, and partners.

We uphold the highest standards of information security, cybersecurity, data privacy, and confidentiality to protect the personal and business information of our employees, customers, suppliers, and partners. We implement appropriate technical, administrative, and organizational controls to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, cyber threats, and misuse of sensitive information.
Employees must safeguard customer, employee, and company data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
Follow company cybersecurity policies to protect sensitive data.
Use strong passwords and enable multi-factor authentication where required.
Report any suspicious emails, phishing attempts, or data breaches immediately.
Do not share confidential company data with unauthorized individuals.
Do not use personal devices to store or transmit company-sensitive information.
Do not click on unknown or suspicious links in emails or messages.
Conflict of Interest: We are committed to identifying, disclosing, and appropriately managing actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest to ensure that business decisions are made objectively, ethically, and in the best interest of the company. Employees, management, and stakeholders are expected to avoid situations where personal, financial, or external interests could improperly influence professional judgement, decision-making, or business relationships.
Employees must disclose any personal or financial interest that could influence their business decisions.
Disclose any personal or financial relationships that could create a conflict of interest.
Seek approval before engaging in any external business relationships related to Ami Lifesciences.
Follow company procedures for reporting conflicts of interest.
Do not make decisions that personally benefit you at the expense of the company.
Do not engage in business with direct competitors without approval.
Do not misuse company resources for personal gain.
Community Development: We actively engage in corporate social responsibility initiatives, supporting local communities and charitable organizations.
Workplace Well-being: We prioritize employee well-being by fostering a positive work environment, providing mental health support, and ensuring a healthy work-life balance.
Transparency in Reporting: We maintain open and honest communication with stakeholders by providing regular reports on ethical compliance and sustainability efforts.
Ethical Innovation: We promote the development of ethical and sustainable products, leveraging research and innovation to minimize environmental and social impact.
Integrity and Honesty: Employees must be honest in all business dealings and avoid deceptive practices.
Fair Competition: Employees must compete fairly and not engage in anti-competitive practices such as price-fixing or market manipulation.
Compete fairly and ethically in the marketplace.
Follow all applicable competition laws and regulations.
Ensure transparency in negotiations and pricing strategies.
Do not engage in price-fixing, bid-rigging, or market allocation schemes.
Do not discuss competitive pricing strategies with competitors.
Do not misuse market influence to eliminate competition unfairly.
Workplace Respect and Inclusion: Discrimination, harassment, and workplace bullying are strictly prohibited.
Ethical Sourcing and Environmental Respo: Suppliers must follow sustainable and ethical labor practices, ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions.
Confidentiality and Data Protection: Employees must safeguard customer, employee, and company data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
Whistleblower Protection: Employees who report ethical violations in good faith will be protected from retaliation.
Any employee or stakeholder reporting violations in good faith will be protected from retaliation.
Fraud Prevention: Report any suspicious activities or bribery attempts to the Compliance Officer.
Do not falsify or manipulate financial records.
Do not engage in fraudulent business dealings or misrepresent facts.
Report any suspicious transactions to the compliance department.
Conduct due diligence before engaging with new business partners.
Maintain accurate financial records and transaction logs.
Do not process or approve transactions that lack clear business justification.
Do not ignore red flags related to suspicious financial activities.
Do not engage in structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements.
Money Laundering Prevention: Report any suspicious transactions to the compliance department.
Conduct due diligence before engaging with new business partners.
Maintain accurate financial records and transaction logs.
Do not process or approve transactions that lack clear business justification.
Do not ignore red flags related to suspicious financial activities.
Do not engage in structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements.
Ethical Supplier Certification: We plan to collaborate with ethically certified suppliers strengthens the integrity of the supply chain by 2030.
Grievance Mechanisms: A formal grievance mechanism is in place to ensure employees and external stakeholders can report violations confidentially and without fear of retaliation.
Grievance reports are reviewed by the Compliance Manager and addressed according to established procedures.

responsibilities.duty: The Board of Directors is responsible for setting the overall ethical direction of Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics, ensuring that ethical considerations are embedded in corporate strategies and decision-making. They: Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of the Ethics Policy. Ensure that ethical risks are identified and mitigated at the highest level. Promote a corporate culture of integrity and responsibility. Provide guidance and resources to support ethical initiatives.

The Compliance Officer plays a critical role in ensuring that Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics operates ethically. Their responsibilities include: Developing and executing ethical policies in alignment with corporate goals. Monitoring compliance with ethical commitments across the organization. Reporting on ethics progress to the Board and stakeholders. Leading initiatives to integrate ethics into corporate social responsibility programs.

Senior Management is responsible for embedding ethical principles into the day-to-day operations of Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics. They: Lead by example in demonstrating ethical behaviour. Ensure all employees are aware of and adhere to the Ethics Policy. Address ethical concerns and take corrective actions when necessary. Foster an open environment where employees feel comfortable reporting ethical issues.

The Sustainability Committee oversees the ethical and sustainability initiatives within the company. Their key responsibilities include: Evaluating the impact of business operations on ethical and sustainability commitments. Engaging with external stakeholders to promote ethical practices. Setting and monitoring ethics-related goals and targets.

Departmental Heads ensure that ethical standards are upheld within their respective teams. They: Communicate the importance of ethical behaviour to employees. Monitor compliance with the Ethics Policy in daily operations. Identify potential ethical risks and address them proactively. Encourage employees to participate in ethics training and awareness programs.

All employees of Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics are expected to uphold the highest ethical standards in their roles. They: Familiarize themselves with and adhere to the Ethics Policy. Report any suspected ethical violations through proper channels. Act with integrity in all professional dealings. Contribute to an ethical workplace culture by treating colleagues, customers, and stakeholders with respect.

policy.monitoring:
All reported violations will be thoroughly investigated by the Compliance Manager and relevant authorities within the company.

Depending on the severity of the violation, corrective actions will be implemented, including policy reinforcement, additional training, or procedural adjustments.

Employees or stakeholders found guilty of ethical misconduct may face disciplinary actions such as warnings, suspension, or termination of employment or business relationships.

In cases involving fraud, corruption, or serious ethical breaches, legal action may be taken in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Any employee or stakeholder reporting violations in good faith will be protected from retaliation.

Ethical compliance audits will be conducted periodically to ensure adherence to company policies and standards.

External reporting is conducted annually to communicate our ethical performance to stakeholders, including employees, customers, investors, and regulatory bodies.

Reports are prepared in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines.

We require suppliers to submit annual reports on their ethical compliance, including any corrective actions taken.

Audits and third-party assessments are conducted to verify compliance with our Supplier Code of Conduct.

We actively engage with employees, suppliers, and other stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and foster transparency in our ethical practices.

Regular stakeholder meetings and surveys help assess the effectiveness of our ethics initiatives and inform continuous improvement efforts.

A formal grievance mechanism is in place to ensure employees and external stakeholders can report violations confidentially and without fear of retaliation.

Grievance reports are reviewed by the Compliance Manager and addressed according to established procedures.
policy.reviewMechanism:
An annual ethics performance review is conducted to assess progress towards ethical goals and compliance with the Ethics Policy.

Key achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement are identified through a comprehensive evaluation process.

Feedback from performance reviews, internal audits, and stakeholder engagement activities is used to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Adjustments to ethical strategies, policies, and action plans are made as necessary to enhance compliance and address emerging issues.

The Compliance Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance with ethical standards.
